pages.text: Liquid Pipes carry $(l)liquids$(): water, lava, Coolant, Cryo Coolant, Acid and the liquids of other mods. $(l)Gases$() (biogas, methane, Steam) need a $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l) instead.$(br2)Typical uses:

$(li)water from a $(l:basics/water_pump)Water Pump$(/l) to a $(l:nuclear/coolant_mixer)Coolant Mixer$(/l), an $(l:generators/acid_synthesizer)Acid Synthesizer$(/l) or a $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l);$(br)$(li)acid to the $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l).
$(li)Pipes $(l)connect by themselves$() to other Liquid Pipes and to any block that holds fluids, from CyberFarm or any other mod.$(br)$(li)All three tiers join into one network.
pages.title: Placing

pages.text: $(li)A Liquid Pipe $(l)never joins a Gas Pipe$(), so the water line into a reactor and the steam line out of it can run side by side.$(br)$(li)To empty a $(l:cables/fluid_tanks)Liquid Tank$(/l) into a machine, $(l)right-click the pipe's arm$() that touches the tank so it pulls (see $(l:cables/cables)Cables$(/l)).

$(li)Pipes $(l)store nothing$(): what a machine pushes in goes straight to the blocks on the network, which take turns.$(br)$(li)The sleeves have $(l)blue lights$().$(br)$(li)While a liquid flows, it fills the glass in its own colour. When the flow stops, the pipe looks empty again.
pages.title: How it works

pages.text: The rate is how much liquid can enter the network per tick from each machine pushing in, set by the pipe that touches it.$(br)$(li)$(l)Liquid Pipe$(): grey, 1,000 mB/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Advanced Liquid Pipe$(): gold, 4,000 mB/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Elite Liquid Pipe$(): violet, 16,000 mB/t
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: To upgrade a line already in place, use the $(l:cables/cable_swapper)Cable Swapper$(/l).
